name: Equatorial Guinea
combinedSummary: Exercise increased caution in Equatorial Guinea.

us.summary:
Exercise increased cautionin Equatorial Guinea due to risk of crime, health, and arbitrary enforcement of laws.
Crime
Petty crime is common throughout the country. Local police may lack the resources to respond effectively to reports of crime, even serious crime.
Health
Medical services in Equatorial Guinea are limited. There are no adequate trauma or ambulance services. Even minor health issues may require medical evacuation at the traveler’s expense. Be sure to bring enough prescription medica
